search_definition: 15 locked routes x 2 directions x 5 advance-purchase windows
request_mode: Synchronous one-way searches with bounded retries for network failures and HTTP 424 upstream errors.
limitations: An Ignav account, verified account email, and API key are required; signup is self-service and does not require partner approval.
The provider's fare, airline, and route coverage varies by search date; verify the Vayu routes in its playground.
Search results are live quotes for future travel dates; they are not a historical archive.
Prices can be verified or unverified; only verified INR fares are eligible for comparisons.
Provider economy results do not expose the Vayu Saver, Standard, and Flexi fare brands, so no fare-class mapping is inferred.
The existing synthetic Vayu index is not replaced by provider quotes; a separate historical real-data build and fare-class mapping are required before production CPI validation.
